item.summary: fix(agents): quota suspension resolves the real owning agent instead of no-opping (#120262) * fix(agents): session quota suspension resolves the real owning agent suspendSession derived the agent id from path.basename(agentDir), which is always the literal 'agent' in the default /agents//agent layout — the quota-suspension marker landed in a nonexistent agent's store and the suspension silently no-opped. Callers now pass the explicit agentId through runWithModelFallback/throwFallbackFailureSummary, with the agent-dir registry as fallback for dir-only callers. * fix(agents): embedded failure suspensions carry the run's agent id
